notes.title: Dev Log: The Peoplesprout Project
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, this is Bone Nail. The Piper of Dawn is deep in development! If you've played our offline demo, you already know the core gameplay: farming → alchemy → shopkeeping, all in one seamless loop. The farming part was tricky to innovate on… so we decided to grow people instead.[/p][p]It all began during a team meeting on cutting down late-game grind.[/p][p] [/p][p]A: This is exhausting. My mouse is dying.[/p][p]B: Got it, working on a hotkey solution.[/p][p]A: My hands are dying too.[/p][p]B: …Want me to try voice controls?[/p][p]A: Why not foot controls while you're at it?[/p][p]B: …Not really into my feet.[/p][p]A: Think, there's gotta be another way.[/p][p]B: What if… we could hire NPCs to do the work?[/p][p]A: We already did that in Yog-Sothoth's Yard. Got anything new?[/p][p]B: What if… we grew the workers in the fields?[/p][p]Everyone: Brilliant![/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692618/f7c747ec3831ed7c1e5a258aacd3d67bf4d08f28.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="center"]Peoplesprout Farm[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]And thus, the Peoplesprout Farm was born.[/p][p]Our motto: [b]Give Peoplesprout a Full Life![/b][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692618/fa5ef262f60aa7ee43f74bc93bde871ea97f028e.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]The value of labor lies in its plentiful harvest. The sweat you sow will bear the fruit of flesh.[/p][p]From there, we refined the idea.[/p][p]Artist: Growing an entire person just to get a single worker feels a bit wasteful, doesn't it? What if, just thinking out loud here, we plant them in parts instead?[/p][p]Like this: \[sketch]. And this: \[sketch]. And this: \[sketch].[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692618/1c01c89947dcadbd22d586abc932c5d15c4915ef.png"][/img][/p][p]...[/p][p]...[/p][p]Turns out we were still playing it too safe.[/p][p]...[/p][p]Plant an eyeball in the spring, harvest a worker in the summer.[/p][p]Plant a brain in the spring, harvest a worker in the summer.[/p][p]Plant a heart in the spring, harvest a worker in the summer.[/p][p]Plant a...[/p][p] [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692618/e42e2baa596ae0bc49de6cafb99627dd9a606bd7.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]After all, the human body is one of the universe's greatest miracles—every part beautiful, useful, and able to function both alone and together.[/p][p]Surely, when faced with the noble cause of farming, they'd cooperate… right?[/p][p]No squabbling, no slacking, no fights…[/p][p] [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692618/9f8cbf5c2500aa9f837dec0f5bab9404fd46dc43.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]And that's how our second-phase farming system took root.[/p][p]We can't wait for you to try it![/p][p] [/p][p]\[Behind the Scenes: Designer vs Artist][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692618/800f667222281d8054278c2f8d02cefcdf7db965.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Piper Steam Page is LIVE! See You This Summer!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, this is Bone Nail, and we're thrilled to finally unveil our new game, the Piper! First things first, don't miss our debut trailer:[/p][p] [/p][previewyoutube="JZhQzwi_YBg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The gameplay footage was recorded from our May build. Of course, by the time you watch it, a lot has already changed![/p][p]The latest version will be playable at upcoming in-person events![/p][p]Our Steam page is now live, so go ahead and add The Piper to your wishlist![/p][p]Project Update: Progress, Events and What's Next[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]So, What's The Piper All About?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]You'll play as a lone wanderer arriving in Diamond City—a so-called "paradise." By luck (and a risky bet), you take over a run-down alchemy workshop and start from scratch: farming, brewing potions, and running your own shop. Along the way, you'll meet all kinds of characters, get involved with various factions (sometimes even fighting them), and build trust to carve your own unique path.[/p][p]Time moves differently in Diamond City... but that's not really a problem, since the "outside world" is long gone. Eventually, every outsider becomes a local, pouring everything they have into building the city.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]How's Development Going?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The Piper is still deep in development! The core gameplay systems are in place, and we're bringing an early demo to conventions to get hands-on feedback for more tuning and improvements.[/p][p]The script is a work in progress. It's even bigger than our last project, Yog-Sothoth's Yard, with more story and tons of new art. To make sure everything's just right, we'll need a bit more time to polish it all.[/p][p] [/p][p]Next up, we'll be demoing at shows like Bilibili World 2025 in Shanghai and BitSummit in Kyoto. We can't wait to see everyone face-to-face this (very hot!) summer.[/p][p]We never want to create in a vacuum. That's why every time we have a playable build, we bring it straight to you—our most valued playtesters—at conventions. At Beijing G-Fusion, we received over a hundred pieces of feedback and suggestions on everything from controls and pacing to balance, new character impressions, and story. We've been working nonstop to make things better, and we're eager to hear even more at upcoming events![/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Build, build, and build some more.[/p][p]Aside from popping up at a few conventions, we're throwing ourselves 100% into development. Everything else can wait until The Piper is ready.[/p][p]The game comes first. Always.[b] [/b][/p][p][b] [/b] [/p][p]Finally, we hope you all have an amazing—and blazing—summer. See you soon![/p]
